description: Synthetic recall set: 40 invented memories of a fictional lens-maker (Mara Voss) and 20 meaning-level queries with gold memory ids. No real person's memories. Five memories are archived, so the 'active' policy caps some queries and the 'faded' policy should recover them.

queries.query: Who were the people that brought you up, and what did they do for a living?
Where did you first set up to make things?
What was the very first thing you and your partner made together and sold?
Did you finish your formal education?
What did studying letterforms teach you?
How did it feel to lose control of the firm you started?
What did you do in the years after you were forced out?
How did you end up back at the company you founded?
Describe your closest collaborator.
Why do you fuss over parts customers never see?
What did facing a serious diagnosis change for you?
How are things with your child?
How do you get to work?
What names do you give your bikes?
What was your biggest hit product?
Did you ever study any spiritual practice?
Why do you always wear the same clothes?
When did you find out you were adopted?
What happened to the original workshop?
What do you think about mortality?
